description: This file defines the OverloadDetector class responsible for determining whether the current process is overloaded based on environment statistics and load shedding options.

classes.name: OverloadDetector
classes.description: A class that detects overload conditions based on environment statistics and configured options.

methods.name: OverloadDetector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the overload detector with environment statistics provider and load shedding options.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Property indicating whether overload detection is enabled.

methods.name: IsOverloaded
methods.description: Property that returns true if the process is currently overloaded, false otherwise.

methods.name: ForceRefresh
methods.description: Method to manually reset the overload detection state, primarily used for testing.
